title: Accessibility and WCAG Checks
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting accessibility and WCAG checks to a WCAG 2.2 audit in which every change cites a success criterion and a reproducible result, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Audit a screen against specific WCAG 2.2 AA success criteria, not general "looks accessible" impressions
Compute and check color contrast against the 4.5:1 threshold for normal text
Write alt text that conveys the information an image carries, not the word "image."
Ensure no status or meaning is communicated by color alone

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
